blocks.headline: How Cypress HomeCare Solutions is redefining aging in place with tech innovation partners.
blocks.subtitle: A family-owned Arizona agency is weaving Able Assess into a culture of innovation — moving conversations about physical wellbeing from subjective feeling to objective fact.

blocks.heading: Innovating in home care
blocks.body:
Cypress HomeCare Solutions (Cypress) is an independent, family-owned in-home supportive care agency based in Scottsdale, Arizona. Co-founded in 1994 and presently led by Managing Partner Bob Roth, a long-standing voice in home care innovation, the agency is built on a culture of innovation philosophy.

Cypress pairs highly trained caregivers with a portfolio of tech solutions — including Gracey Care, Sensi.ai, and their internally developed SmartAutomations.care — all organised around the singular goal of keeping clients safe at home. For Bob, Able Assess is a natural addition to the innovative solutions Cypress brings to the clients they serve.

blocks.heading: A new standard of clinical differentiation
blocks.body:
In a competitive landscape, Able Assess is one tool in the Cypress tool belt that allows them to stand out from the crowd. David Sax, Cypress HomeCare Solutions Manager of Client Care Innovation, remarked that Able Assess allows Cypress to offer clinical insights during their application of care by providing early identification of changes in physical condition.

Bob also noted that it helps move the conversation about physical wellbeing from subjective "feeling" to objective "fact," with the hardware itself playing a psychological role in building trust with the client.

By holding fall prevention events and providing these data-driven insights, Cypress doesn't just claim to care — they demonstrate their commitment to client wellbeing, setting a new benchmark for what home care can achieve.

blocks.heading: Driving growth through community engagement
blocks.body:
Cypress utilises Able Assess as a powerful engine for customer acquisition. By hosting fall prevention events at senior living communities, they provide a high-value service that serves as a sophisticated relationship builder. These screenings allow the Cypress team to offer immediate, actionable insights to residents who may not yet realise they are at risk, instantly establishing the agency as a trusted resource with clinical insights.

The physical presence of the technology allows Cypress to identify at-risk individuals early, transforming a simple introduction into a data-backed health consultation. This proactive approach demonstrates a deep commitment to the wellbeing of the entire community, positioning Cypress as a vital partner to the senior living facilities themselves rather than just another outside provider.

blocks.heading: Enhancing longevity and customer retention
blocks.body:
At the heart of the Cypress mission is a commitment to longevity, driven by the understanding that falls and medication adherence are the two primary reasons clients end up in urgent care. Bob's strategy is to weave Able Assess into the very fabric of the client experience, creating a clinical shield around the home.

This begins the moment a new relationship is formed; Bob's team utilises the technology at every open, establishing an objective baseline from day one — enabling them to periodically check how a customer is doing and catch decline before it leads to a crisis.

Ultimately, this data-driven oversight is about more than just metrics; it is about the fundamental goal of helping clients live the best lives they possibly can in their own environments. By preventing falls, Cypress protects the sanctity of the home and the dignity of the individual. If the clinical insights provided by Able Assess can ensure that clients are able to live with dignity in their homes — rather than in a skilled nursing facility, assisted living home or community — then the technology has fulfilled its highest purpose.
